description: Check whether a French company is in, or has been through, a collective insolvency proceeding, from its 9-digit SIREN (or 14-digit SIRET), using the official BODACC notices. Returns the company status (active/closed) and its trade name (never a sole trader's personal name), the current proceeding state (none, safeguard, receivership, liquidation, safeguard or receivership plan, closures), the dated court events with the court and a link to each official notice, the deregistration notice when there is one, and the matching stable signal codes (e.g. LIQUIDATION_JUDICIAIRE_EN_COURS, RADIATION_RCS). Same reading of BODACC as verifier_entreprise. When to use another tool: this is the cheap, focused check (before granting credit, paying an invoice in advance or onboarding a supplier). For the full KYB (identity, revenue, EU VAT, overall verdict, signed attestation), call verifier_entreprise. If you only know the name, call rechercher_entreprise first. Errors (never charged): an invalid SIREN is rejected before any payment request; an unknown or non-public company, or BODACC being unreachable (no partial answer is sold), returns an error and is not settled. Payment: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base). No account or API key.

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN of the company (Luhn-valid); a 14-digit SIRET is also accepted. Spaces, dots and dashes are accepted.
